_doc: F-216: display-row corrections for community packs (lib/model_sources.apply_pack_row_fixes), applied to every pack that ships the named model file, after the scan - so the picker and `zep model curate` both see them. For packs that replaced a model in place but left some of its displays' rows naming skins for the OLD model. Keyed by model path; rows: {display id: {column: value}}; 'only_if' guards each value against the stock one it replaces.

creature/mechastrider/mechastrider.m2.note: patch-hd-everything's HD mechastrider draws a two-part skin (slot 1 colour + slot 2 its '...1' half; slot 2 empty -> the model's hardcoded red Mechastrider1). The pack set slot 2 on 7 of its 12 displays and ships every half; these 5 kept stock's blank slot 2.

creature/mechastrider/pvpmechastrider.m2.note: Same two-part skin on the HD PvP mechastrider: slot 2 must be the colour's '...1' half. These 4 displays keep stock's PvPMechaStriderHeadlightGlow there (a glow texture for the OLD model); the pack ships each half.
